contradictions.topic: Loss state / location of vehicle and insured

a.quote: Loss state: TX; Plate: TX SLX-4471

b.quote: Policy CA-FL-4471-19 / Tampa, FL ... Plate FL SLX-4471

contradictions.note: The structured record says Texas; the estimate puts the insured, the plate, the shop and the parts pricing in Florida. Which state applies changes the rules and deadlines for the claim.

b.quote: struck a stationary parking-lot bollard at low speed while pulling into a parking space

contradictions.note: Backing up versus pulling forward. All the damage on file is to the front left, which fits the estimate's account rather than a backing incident.

contradictions.topic: Market used to check repair pricing

a.quote: line items reasonable for TX market on first pass

b.quote: Prices per CCC ONE parts feed, Tampa FL market

contradictions.note: The adjuster's reasonableness check may have used the wrong market. This follows from the state contradiction above.

The intake record shows the claim paid, with handling time and a post-closure satisfaction score, but the status history has no first touch and no close date, and the adjuster notes say the claim is only queued for coverage review.
Marked as remove and refit, yet charged as a new part with a part number.

packet.rationale: The packet contains the ClaimsPro and Snowflake intake record, the adjuster notes (adjuster_notes.md), the 4-page shop estimate GC-24418 (repair_estimate.pdf) and 2 damage photos (IMG_0071.jpg, IMG_0072.jpg); the checklist is complete and the estimate total of 2,825.07 matches the intake amount. The date of loss is blank in every source and the policy period is not in the record, so neither coverage at the time of loss nor timely filing can yet be checked. The intake record gives the loss state and plate as Texas, while repair_estimate.pdf places the insured, the plate, the shop and the pricing in Tampa, Florida. adjuster_notes.md describes a backing incident, while repair_estimate.pdf describes pulling forward into a bollard. The intake record shows 'Paid in Full' while status_history.md shows the claim only received and assigned. The claim needs information requested from the insured: the date of loss, confirmation of where the loss happened and which state applies, the policy period, and a consistent account of the incident, before a person can decide it. No denial indicator is supported by positive evidence on file.
